name: DIF-Gaussian
definition: A neural network that reconstructs a 3D volume from multi-view 2D projections by predicting 3D Gaussian parameters at sampled points and decoding features via Gaussian interpolation.
summary: DIF-Gaussian is a feed-forward neural network that reconstructs 3D volumes from multi-view projections by explicitly modeling feature aggregation as a differentiable Gaussian splatting operation.
